correctness.rationale: Boolean-polynomial supports turn addition into union and multiplication into Minkowski sum. The proved shift-cover criterion is necessary and sufficient for ideal membership because no cancellation is possible. There are exactly \(15\) nonzero linear supports, so all \(2^{15}=32768\) generating subsets are exhaustively covered. Linear closure is a complete ideal key because \((\mathcal G)=(C(\mathcal G))\). Replay independently reconstructs \(1748\) closures and checks explicit \(f,g\notin I\), \(fg\in I\) witnesses for all \(1721\) non-variable-generated eligible closures. The remaining \(7\) eligible ideals are proved prime by the monomial-avoidance argument.
